items.title: Boeing Stock Skids As CEO Warns Of Further 737 Production Delays
items.summary: Boeing stock fell as much as 6% on Wednesday after CEO Kelly Ortberg said stable production of the 737 Max would take longer than expected.

items.title: Boeing’s Commercial Delays Threaten to Clip Its Wings
items.summary: Boeing is still pumping out more passenger planes than a year ago, but executives warned that a handful of threats loom on the horizon.  "We are not stable yet at 47 a month," Ortberg said at an investor conference Wednesday.  Regulatory work on the troubled 777X model could also "spill into next year" due to engine certification issues, Ortberg said.

items.title: Why Boeing Stock Is Sliding
items.summary: Boeing  stock dropped in late trading Wednesday after management made comments at an investor conference.  Production of the 737 MAX was “not stable at 47 a month,” said CEO Kelly Ortberg while speaking at a Morgan Stanley conference.  It was taking a little longer than expected to ramp and stabilize production, he added, with wing production an issue.

items.title: BA Stock Drops Over 5% After Boeing CEO Says 737 Production Is Still Not Stable — 777X Deliveries On Track For 2027
items.summary: Kelly Ortberg said Boeing is taking longer than expected to stabilize 737 output at 47 aircraft per month, while the company maintained its 2027 777X delivery target.

items.title: Boeing stock tumbles after CEO flags production, cash flow concerns
items.summary: Investing.com -- Boeing (NYSE:BA) shares fell 6% Wednesday after President and Chief Executive Officer Kelly Ortberg spoke at the Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference, where he outlined several challenges facing the aerospace manufacturer.

items.title: How Far Can GE Stock Move When The Work Is Already Booked?
items.summary: GE Aerospace (GE) has more engine work booked than it can currently perform, and that visibility is much of why people own the shares. The option chain does not treat the stock as settled. At about $307, contracts running twelve months out carry a band from near $216.93 to near $434.6, with roughly a two-in-three chance the stock finishes inside it.
